notes: [cobblekeep-01 on adbec4f4 (the fleet after plinthfirst-01; use ONLY if the fleet is adbec4f4): branch cobblekeep-on-adbec4f] WHY BOTS KEEP THEIR COBBLE (OWNER 10-19 ~12:15Z 'yes do that'). Measured 10-19 (ES 24 h, docs/reports/cobblekeep-01-cause-2026-10-19.md): 609 of 613 town deposits refused the bag's cobble -- 446 cobble_unknown (a town container never counted: _lid_clear lid=dirt 3,774 / oak_leaves 422 of 4,200 refusals in 60 h; every UNKNOWN town's stale key is a refused lid) and 163 cobble_cap -- while the well threw cobble on 33 of 232 visits (9,738), only when the 1 h floor held the cap (floor/lb 0-98%; towns at 999/981 can take no whole stack). Bags 91% full, ~420 cobble per bot. THE CHANGE: (1) lidrule.mjs LID_BREAKABLE + dirt, grass_block; (2) chestLidBlocked: leaves and glass (LID_OPENS, both measured on Paper) are no lid -- the bot opens; other never-conductors stay lids; (3) cobblecap.mjs wellCobbleSwitch: the well also throws a stack the bank's own admission refuses at the cap on COUNTED stock (6 h counts, the smaller of equal captures, less takes, NO incoming reservation), AT TOWN ONLY (the room order's guess from afar stays floor-only: no new trip home); a withdraw hold on cobble keeps it. Reserves unchanged (64; the exit contract needs 59). Paper sandbox3 10-19: liddirt/lidleaves/cobbleband base vs candidate (report section 3). BEHAVIOUR change: canary. CLASS bag-fix (decided explicitly, Claude r2 P3-2): it empties full bags of cobble at town, which frees slots for more mining -- the exposure the owner's 10-07 rule names; mechanism-linked rows are _lid_clear and _well_dispose. The coordinator may set class '' for the ordinary gate (1 pool, two-death floor). PART 2, COAL AND IRON (owner scope addition 10-19 ~14:10Z, 'coal and iron must get banked in town'): towndeposit.mjs ironKeeps replaces the keep-everything IRON_LADDER floor: 3 iron units per iron craft not yet made (bucket, iron pickaxe; never fewer than 3), ingots first, then raw, then ore, each name whole; coal/charcoal whole while the bot keeps raw iron/ore or a wanted smelt input of its own. 10-19 bags: coal 89, raw iron 26, ingots 124 (max 3 per bot); the keep frees 89 coal (22 bots) and 21 raw iron (11 bots), no ingot (r4 snapshot). Banked raw iron sits in town as raw: the town smelt job smelts copper only, so toolkit no_iron is NOT expected to move (a raw-iron town smelt job is a separate follow-up); banked coal feeds the copper job's no_fuel stops. Paper ironbank: base banks nothing, candidate banks coal:7,raw_iron:5 and keeps 3 ingots.
